entries.author: GEORGIUS CEDRENUS
entries.title: Georgii Cedreni Compendium historiarum a mundo condito usque ad annum 1007, cui subjiciuntur Excerpta ex Breviario historico Joannis Scylitzae Curopalatae
entries.note: Elenchus prints 23 (the only column it carries); Ordo reads 29, a misread. Greek head (SYNOPSIS ISTORION ... KEDRENOY) at line 801, Latin 'COMPENDIUM HISTORIARUM' at 815, col 23|24. Title page proper at lines 160-180 precedes col 9. Scylitzes Excerpta are named in the body title-page (line 180) but the Elenchus lists them inside this one item; no separate Elenchus column.

problems: Elenchus cut lists no columns except 23 for the Compendium; the five editorial items are body-only, with Ordo as cross-check (Ordo digits garbled for Dedicatio 44 and Xylander 28).
Monitum and Notitia columns (9) are inferred from OCR anchors (first anchor in OCR is 11), not read as printed numbers.
Scylitzes Excerpta not separately listed in Elenchus; no body column checked for where the Excerpta begin (left inside the Compendium entry).
Elenchus date 'annum 1007' kept as the OCR reads it (title may read 1057 in print).
